description: Spacing and sizes in dp / pt / CSS px, on a 4-point grid (2 for hairline gaps). Screens use a role or a scale name, never a number.

pageMargin.use: Left and right margin of a screen

sectionGap.use: Between sections and cards on a screen

rowGap.use: Between rows or items in a group

inlineGap.use: Between an icon and its text, or small inline items

listRow.use: Height of a standard row (goal row, settings row)

iconSmall.use: Small icon inside text or chips

ringSmall.use: Progress ring in a goal row

control.use: Height of buttons and text fields

logo.use: The Awrad logo on welcome and sign-in screens

contentMaxWidth.use: Widest a page's content column grows (web, tablets)
